title: Developers Warn Flood of Vibe-Coded Apps Could Slow Apple Approvals - Business Insider
summary: Vibe coding has led to a surge in app submissions to the App Store, causing longer wait times for approval and concerns over increased AI slop. Developers express frustration over the slow approval process, while Apple maintains that 90% of submissions are reviewed within 48 hours.
sentiment_reason: The article presents a negative sentiment due to the frustration of developers over longer wait times and potential stricter review processes, despite Apple's assurance of a generally efficient review system.
